OKE.thesis_one_line: A pipeline operator moving Permian gas and liquids to the Gulf Coast, using a fixed-return outside investor to fund growth and cut debt.
key_adverse_facts: Apollo $9bn Class B interest (closed 2026-09-10) is structurally ahead of common equity and takes 15% of OpCo cash flow, with return capped at 7.0% IRR for nine years
H1 2026 Natural Gas Pipelines EBITDA includes +$169m from Waha-Katy price differentials (spread-driven, not contracted)
Consolidated net debt/TTM adj. EBITDA ~3.9x at 30 Jun 2026; dividends (~$2.64bn TTM) barely covered by OCF less capex and affiliate contributions
$1bn at-the-market common equity program signed 2026-08-04; Brazos Midland $4.425bn deal still needs HSR clearance
Latest guidance (3 Aug 2026) predates Brazos and Class B; company has not republished
data_conflicts: Triage cited leverage 4.3x and FCF yield 1.6%; filings give ~3.9x consolidated TTM and OCF-minus-capex yield ~5.2% (Yahoo FCF field of $0.9bn deducts affiliate contributions and other investing)
OKE.next_earnings_note: estimate from prior-year pattern (Q3 2025 reported 2025-10-28); not confirmed in filings
OKE.confidence_in_thesis: medium: contracted fee-based volumes and two guidance raises, offset by new subordinated Class B claim, spread-driven earnings and unpublished pro forma guidance

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for OKE. Reverse DCF implies ~0.9% 10-year unlevered FCF growth at 7.5% WACC versus ~3.5% base, so implied is below base.

OKE.scenario_basis: Start 2026 guided EPS $5.68 (pre-Class B), pro forma 2027 ~$5.9 after ~$0.62bn Class B income; base EBITDA growth ~5%/yr to 2029 EPS ~$6.65, exit 14.5x, dividend $4.28 growing 3%/yr (~$13.5 cumulative); bear 2029 EPS $5.2 at 12x; bull $7.4 at 16x.
kill_criteria: Consolidated debt less cash divided by TTM adjusted EBITDA (earnings-release reconciliation) above 3.75x at any quarter-end after Brazos closes, or still above 3.9x at the June 2027 quarter.
Adjusted EBITDA 2026 guidance cut below the $8.2bn low end, or any later guidance midpoint below $9.0bn for 2027 including Brazos.
Quarterly common dividend cut below $1.07 per share.
NGL raw feed throughput below 1,450 MBbl/d (low end of 2026 volume guidance) for two consecutive quarters.
Common equity issuance above the $1bn at-the-market program, or further minority/preferred capital above $2bn.

FISV.thesis_one_line: Software and card-payment company for banks and merchants whose sales are shrinking; the share price already assumes steady decline.
key_adverse_facts: Organic revenue -5% in Q2 2026 (Merchant -1%, Financial -8%); adjusted operating margin 31.8% vs 39.6%
FY26 guidance cut on 2026-08-06: adjusted EPS $8.00-8.30 to $7.20-7.40 and organic revenue +1% to +3% to (1%)-0%, three months after being maintained on 2026-05-05
President resigned for good reason 2026-07-07; Chief Administrative and Chief Legal Officer resigned 2026-09-16
Securities class action in SDNY (No. 1:25-cv-06094) over Clover growth and Argentina statements, class period 2024-02-06 to 2025-10-28
Restructuring add-backs recur (H1 2026 transformation $329m + severance $113m); buybacks cut to $300m in H1 from $5.9bn in FY25; net debt ~3.7x adj. EBITDA (estimate)
data_conflicts: Triage said guidance was cut twice within 2026; the 2026-05-05 release maintained it and the only 2026 cut is 2026-08-06
Company-defined FCF ($4.25bn TTM) adds back severance/transformation payments; OCF minus capex is ~$3.9bn
FISV.next_earnings_note: estimate from prior-year pattern (Q3 2025 reported 2025-10-29); not confirmed
FISV.confidence_in_thesis: low: cheap on cash flow but trend, leadership and guidance credibility are all deteriorating; floor unproven

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for FISV. Reverse DCF on equity cash flow (cost of equity 11%) implies about -4.6%/yr 10-year growth versus ~+0.5% base, so implied is below base; WATCH because of the show-me conditions, not valuation.

FISV.scenario_basis: Start FY26 adjusted EPS guide midpoint $7.30 (non-GAAP); base 2029 adjusted EPS $7.8 (~2%/yr incl. buybacks) at 7.5x = $58.5; bear $5.5 at 6x; bull $9.5 at 9.5x; no dividend.
kill_criteria: Organic revenue worse than -6% in any quarter, or no better than -3% by Q1 2027.
FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance cut below $7.20 (the low end), or FY2026 adjusted EPS delivered below $7.20.
Net debt (consolidated debt less cash, excl. settlement assets) divided by adjusted EBITDA above 4.0x.
Company-defined free cash flow for FY2026 below $3.5bn (H1 was $1.36bn).
SEC enforcement action, restatement or auditor qualification connected to Clover revenue recognition.

PFE.thesis_one_line: A global drugmaker priced cheaply and paying a 6% dividend, but profits look flat as key medicines face lower prices and generics.
key_adverse_facts: H1 2026 adjusted EPS $1.52 vs $1.69 (-10%); Q2 GAAP loss $(0.04) after $4.3bn of intangible impairments
TTM OCF minus capex ~$11.0bn covers dividends (~$9.8bn) only ~1.1x; debt $63.2bn, net debt ~$51.5bn; no buybacks in 2026
US price pressure: Eliquis negotiated price effective 2026-01-01, Ibrance and Xtandi 2027, MFN/TrumpRx agreements, Section 232 pharma tariffs effective for Pfizer 2026-07-31
COVID revenue outlook cut to ~$4bn from ~$5bn; $650m Innovent IPR&D charge (~$0.10) lands in Q3 2026
CFO transition (interim CFO named in Aug 2026 release); Zantac MDL and Chantix class actions ongoing
data_conflicts: Yahoo trailing EPS $0.76 reflects impairments; adjusted EPS guidance is $2.80-3.00
Yahoo total debt $63.48bn vs XBRL carrying $63.19bn (basis difference)
PFE.next_earnings_note: estimate from prior-year pattern (Q3 2025 reported 2025-11-04); not confirmed
PFE.confidence_in_thesis: low-medium: reliable EPS guidance record, but post-2027 growth bridge unproven and patent-expiry dates not verified in this pass

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for PFE. Reverse DCF on equity FCF (cost of equity 8.5%) implies ~+2.4%/yr 10-year growth versus ~-1% base, so implied is above base. [Corrected 2026-10-08 (DV33): with SBC (TTM $0.95bn) deducted and the programme rate (Ke 7.37%, 3% terminal) the price implies about -1.6% a year versus a -1% base, i.e. in line; at the dossier's 8.5%/1% parameters with SBC deducted it is +3.6% (above). WATCH unchanged on dividend cover and growth risk.]

PFE.scenario_basis: Start 2026 adjusted EPS guide midpoint $2.90 (non-GAAP); base 2029 EPS $2.80 at 10.5x = $29.4 plus dividend $1.72 x3 = $5.16; bear $2.2 at 9x; bull $3.5 at 12x.
kill_criteria: FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance cut below $2.80 (the current low end).
Common dividend cut, or TTM OCF minus capex below TTM dividends paid for two consecutive quarters.
Net debt (consolidated debt less cash and short-term investments) above $55bn.
Launched and acquired products' operational revenue growth below 10% for two consecutive quarters (Q2'26: 18%).
FY2027 revenue guidance midpoint below $58bn when issued.
